summary: RFC 5328 registered the URN namespace dvb for the Digital Video Broadcasting Project. This document updates that registration with new registrant information.

eli5.summary: A club once signed up a name, and now their contact details changed. This note simply updates the contact information on that name registration.

who is the dvb urn registrant
subtitle: A short update that swaps in new contact details for the registered dvb URN namespace.

tldr.problem: RFC 5328 registered the URN namespace dvb for the Digital Video Broadcasting Project, but the registrant contact information changed after it was published.
tldr.mechanism: RFC 7354 replaces two fields of that registration, Registration Information and Declared registrant of the namespace, with current values and uses a role-based email address.
tldr.outcome: Everything else in the RFC 5328 registration stays as it was, and IANA now lists both RFCs for the dvb namespace.

today: RFC 7354 is an Informational document that updates RFC 5328, and no later RFC is listed as obsoleting or updating it.

sections.title: Why the Registration Needed Updating
sections.content:
RFC 5328 registered the Uniform Resource Name (URN) namespace dvb for the Digital Video Broadcasting Project. Since that RFC was published, the registrant contact information has changed.

This document makes the information current. It also uses a role-based email address, which is meant to reduce the need for further updates in the future.
sections.eli5: Phone numbers and people change. This note fixes the contact card so it is right again.

sections.title: The Registration Update
sections.content:
The update replaces the Registration Information and Declared registrant of the namespace fields from Section 2 of RFC 5328. The new registration information is Version: 2 and Date: 2014-08-11.

The declared registrant is Peter Siebert, Executive Director of the DVB Project Office, with a Geneva address and the email address dvb@dvb.org. All other fields in the registration remain as specified in RFC 5328.
sections.eli5: Only the name tag and the contact card get swapped. The rest of the original sign-up form is untouched.

sections.title: Security and IANA Notes
sections.content:
The RFC states that there are no security considerations for this registration update.

In the Formal URN Namespaces registry, IANA has added a reference to this RFC, in addition to RFC 5328, for the dvb namespace. The reference field now contains two RFC numbers.
sections.eli5: The big list of names now points to both notes, the old one and this new one.

references.text: Adolf, A. and P. MacAvock, "A Uniform Resource Name (URN) Namespace for the Digital Video Broadcasting Project (DVB)", RFC 5328, September 2008.
